title: Exact representability
rationale: The default for every new scan program (docs/design/plans/scan-engines-and-expert-scan.md §2.6). A scan runs exactly as requested or not at all: every duration, edge, separation and repeat period must be a whole number of the engine's timing-grid steps. Nothing is rounded, so nothing in the experiment changes without the user choosing it; a value that is not representable is refused with its representable neighbours.
